jobs.title: Version the swarm dispatch and readiness contract
jobs.gap: Grant-scoped MCP exists, but router job identity, requested tools, binding expectations and readiness need one explicit versioned dispatch contract.
jobs.deliverable: Add a values-free dispatch request/response schema and compatibility fixtures for the router; separate metadata readiness from provider execution readiness.
acceptance: Bind job ID, agent ID, public grant ID, expected binding and exact tool set without accepting identity from untrusted MCP metadata.
Unknown versions, absent authority, stale reports and scope mismatch refuse dispatch with stable codes and no credential-bearing worker spawn.
Document trusted operator versus agent responsibilities and schema upgrade behavior; retain existing handshake compatibility.
Enforce the workspace allowed_bindings and expected binding at dispatch; reject wrong-workspace authority without agent force or re-pin.

jobs.title: Preflight graph intent against live authority
jobs.gap: Startup checks live grants and loads an immutable graph; operators need actionable validation of requested versus effective tools before dispatch.
jobs.deliverable: Add a credential-free graph preflight with structured per-node readiness and a stable graph digest for dispatch correlation.
acceptance: Validate every graph grant, sealed session and exact requested tool against the live catalog without resolving credentials.
Report absent tools as blockers for requested execution, while retaining empty-graph and empty-tool deny-all semantics.
Reject duplicate, wildcard, oversized and unknown-field input; do not echo attacker-controlled payloads or mint authority.
Make clear that editing a manifest does not revoke a running snapshot; operator revoke plus restart remains the supported workflow.

jobs.title: Specify the tenant-scoped Phantom execution bridge
external_dependencies: Phantom Secrets owner must review and implement a scoped value-blind execution endpoint; no endpoint or release is assumed available.
jobs.gap: phm: references are metadata only and currently refuse resolution; no supported scoped value-blind bridge exists.
jobs.deliverable: Land a reviewed bridge protocol, mock conformance harness and explicit availability negotiation; keep production resolution disabled until the Phantom counterpart passes.
acceptance: Bind credential reference, tenant, provider, operation and expiry to independently authenticated authority; reject substitution and replay.
Never invoke or capture phantom reveal, return secret bytes to the model, or translate unavailable phm: references to ambient env credentials.
Mock missing, expired, revoked and cross-tenant responses; preserve existing unsupported behavior until both sides explicitly negotiate a supported protocol.

jobs.title: Add an explicit grant-scoped CLI execution contract
jobs.gap: exec --for isolates one provider but does not validate arbitrary native flags, sandbox the executable, or inherit MCP tool policy.
jobs.deliverable: Introduce a separate restricted CLI operation surface for swarm jobs with exact executable and operation mappings, independent of ordinary trusted exec.
acceptance: Derive identity from operator-issued job authority; agents cannot pin, choose another binding or gain executor/control capabilities.
Allow only reviewed adapter operations; reject shells, wrappers, response files, endpoint/config overrides and unknown flags before spawn.
Enforce frozen scopes and external approval before destructive execution; do not treat local approval labels as authorization.
Use a fresh private HOME, selected-provider credentials only, bounded redacted output and preserved child status; prove wrong-tenant credentials never enter the child.
Retain trusted exec compatibility and accurately document its weaker boundary; unsupported CLIs fail closed on the restricted surface.

jobs.title: Close job lifecycle and authority cleanup
jobs.gap: Grant revocation closes subsequent requests; the swarm docs explicitly allow already-authorized calls to finish. Job cancellation needs a precise lifecycle across MCP and restricted CLI.
jobs.deliverable: Define and implement idempotent dispatch, completion, cancellation and crash cleanup for job-owned grants, sessions and process trees.
acceptance: Retries cannot create duplicate active authority; cleanup affects only resources owned by the target job.
Revoke before cleanup so new calls refuse; specify which in-flight operations can be interrupted and never promise rollback of remote effects.
Expiry, operator revoke, parent death and broker restart leave no reusable job authority or orphan credential-bearing workers.
Prove cancelling agent A does not terminate agent B, including same-tenant and cross-tenant cases.

jobs.title: Bound broker resources per agent
jobs.gap: Manifest and transport limits exist; swarm fairness and overload behavior need explicit per-agent execution limits rather than assuming session spend budgets cover them.
jobs.deliverable: Add bounded per-agent concurrency, queue length, request duration and output size with stable overload errors and operator limits.
acceptance: A noisy grant cannot exhaust every execution slot; global and per-agent limits are enforced atomically.
Timeout and disconnect cleanup releases capacity without retrying non-idempotent operations or dropping policy checks.
Use deterministic blocked-worker tests to prove fairness, cancellation and bounded output; report measured latency and limits without inventing an SLO.

jobs.title: Correlate dispatch decisions with execution outcomes
jobs.gap: Swarm audit records graph decisions and public grant IDs; graph allowed is not proof of successful execution and router job correlation needs a shared contract.
jobs.deliverable: Add values-free job/request correlation and terminal outcome records across MCP and restricted CLI, plus an operator diagnostic view.
acceptance: Distinguish graph admission, policy/approval refusal, worker start, completion, timeout and cancellation; stable IDs join records without raw arguments.
Never log bearers, credential values, arbitrary command output or secret-bearing arguments; scan synthetic sentinels across stdout, stderr and audit exports.
Audit admission failure remains fail closed; post-execution audit failure reports uncertainty and never replays a destructive operation.
Diagnostics state when operator re-pin, grant replacement or Phantom availability is required without performing authority changes.

jobs.title: Integrate router dispatch with the broker contract
external_dependencies: Ashlr router owner must adopt and validate the dispatch contract in its own repository.
Phantom Secrets bridge implementation and compatibility evidence from RQ-LOCUS-03 are required for Phantom-backed production dispatch.
jobs.gap: Existing hub helpers have optional warn/off modes and ephemeral sessions; mandatory brokered swarm dispatch needs a distinct enforced integration and downstream adoption.
jobs.deliverable: Ship a Locus-owned router integration harness and updated drop-in; hand off the production router change with exact request/response fixtures.
acceptance: New brokered swarm dispatch blocks when readiness, requested tools or authority is unavailable; warn/off modes never authorize this new path.
Provision one operator-authorized grant per agent, register only intended broker/Secrets endpoints, and never fall back to ambient provider MCPs or native CLIs.
Handle cancellation and retry through the lifecycle contract; no shared active-pin races or bearer values in job payloads/logs.
Run two concurrent synthetic jobs with disjoint tools; swapping job/grant/session identifiers refuses before side effects.
Document env-backed fixture operation separately from Phantom-backed production readiness; missing Phantom bridge blocks the latter.

jobs.title: Prove end-to-end isolation and stage operator rollout
jobs.gap: Existing protocol and isolation suites cover important gates; the complete router-to-MCP/restricted-CLI lifecycle needs one reproducible evidence pack.
jobs.deliverable: Add an isolated offline swarm conformance scenario and operator rollout/rollback runbook with explicit release gates.
acceptance: Use temporary HOME and LOCUS_HOME, synthetic credentials and fake upstreams; require no network account, real pin or live secret.
Cover two tenants and two same-tenant agents, forged selectors, stale graph, revoked/expired authority, broker crash, worker timeout, audit failure and unavailable Phantom.
Assert denied operations produce zero fake-provider side effects and no secret sentinels in model-visible output, logs or audits.
Gate rollout on all conformance checks plus downstream router/Phantom evidence; start with operator-owned read-only canary then explicitly approved mutation.
Rollback revokes affected grants, stops owned workers and restores the known-good broker config; never falls back to unbrokered access.
